contributions.anchor: cover 'Campaign Financial Summary' line 1 Total Contributions, THIS REPORT cell, handwritten '38475.00' (the Last Report cell is EMPTY and the Cumulative Total cell repeats 38475.00)
contributions.detail: 25 contribution rows sum to 38,375.00 against the filer's handwritten cover figure of 38,475.00 - a FILER delta of -100.00, retained verbatim and never nudged. Traced as far as the document allows: the schedule prints no total of its own (2026 form variant), so the cover cell is the only anchor; every one of the 25 amounts was re-read off a 700 dpi crop of the whole amount column and again at 900 dpi for the first and last rows, and the column is machine-typed and unambiguous (5,000 / 2,500 / 2,500 / 500 / 100 / 100 / 500 / 200 / 25 / 50 / 100 / 250 / 100 / 200 / 200 / 100 / 300 / 50 / 500 / 250 / 3,750 / 500 / 500 / 20,000 / 100). The printed grid has exactly 25 data bands and all 25 are filled, so no row is missing. CORROBORATION (not an anchor - no figure here is synthesized across filings): the 2026-08-01 totals tranche recorded that this same filer's NEXT report, in May, carries 38,375.00 - the row sum, not 38,475.00 - in its own Last-Report column, i.e. the filer himself later used the schedule's figure. The cover's own cross-arithmetic uses 38,475.00 (38,475.00 - 12,994.49 = 25,480.51 = the printed Ending Balance), which is why the delta is reported against it rather than resolved away. Both in-kind conventions tested: no row on this schedule is labelled in-kind, so they give the same 38,375.00.

expenditures.anchor: cover 'Campaign Financial Summary' line 2 Total Campaign Expenditures - This Report AND Cumulative Total both handwritten 12994.49 (Last Report empty)
expenditures.detail: 22 expenditure rows sum to 12,994.49 exactly - to the cent - against the cover's line-2 figure, which the filer wrote identically in the This-Report and Cumulative columns (this is a first report of the cycle: the Last-Report column is blank, so period and cumulative scope coincide and `exact` is the right verdict). The schedule prints no total of its own. The printed grid has 23 data bands; 22 carry entries and the 23rd is blank, which is an independent row-count gate on the transcription.

Two 700 dpi --value strips of the entire amount column (p3 contributions, p2 expenditures) to re-read every figure against the cover; then five 900 dpi tight --value cell crops for the geometry proof: p3 row 1 ('5,000.00') and row 25 ('100.00'), p2 row 1 ('50.00') and row 22 ('5.35'), plus p2 band 23 which came back EMPTY and so confirmed the sheet's last band is an unused row rather than a dropped entry.

itemized.notes: Richard Hyer, 2026 cycle, '7 days before the candidates' convention - Convention' report, signed 4-2-2026. HANDWRITTEN cover over the new 2026 form variant, with MACHINE-TYPED spreadsheet schedules. PAGE ORDER IS REVERSED relative to the form's own naming: p2 is the EXPENDITURES sheet and p3 the CONTRIBUTIONS sheet, and each is a plain typed table headed only by the word 'Expenditures' / 'Contributions' - neither carries a Form A / Form B banner and neither prints a schedule total. Page position is therefore not a classifier here; each sheet was classified from its own printed heading and column set. COUNTY OVER-REDACTION: the black bar over the Street Address / City,Zip block extends across the Home/Office Phone and the NAME OF OFFICE line, so the office this candidate sought is not recoverable from this copy - a publisher redaction, not a filer omission and not an unread field; nothing behind it is reconstructed. The schedules carry CITY AND STATE only (no street addresses), so nothing had to be withheld from the rows for privacy. The cover's line-1 This-Report figure (38,475.00) is 100.00 above the sum of the filer's own 25 itemized rows (38,375.00) - retained as a delta, see recon. One donor row is the candidate's own 20,000.00 loan and one is a transfer from another candidate's campaign committee ('Karen Peterson Campaign'). For online vendors the filer wrote 'Internet' in the City column; that is the document's own value, not a gap.
